name: correlation
description: Compute the pairwise correlation matrix between numeric columns, optionally labelling each coefficient with a human-readable strength category.
usage: Provide ``columns`` (the numeric columns to correlate) and optionally ``method`` (pearson/kendall/spearman). Use ``by_group`` to compute the correlation of the first two columns per group, and ``add_categorization`` to append readable strength labels (e.g. "Strong positive correlation").

attributes.name: reset_index
attributes.description: If ``True`` (default), reset the index on the result.

attributes.name: numeric_only
attributes.description: If ``True`` (default), include only numeric columns in the correlation.

attributes.name: columns
attributes.description: Column names to include in the correlation analysis (at least two for a meaningful pairwise result).

attributes.name: method
attributes.description: Correlation method passed to pandas ``corr``: ``pearson`` (default, linear), ``kendall`` (rank, tau), or ``spearman`` (rank).

attributes.name: by_group
attributes.description: Column to group rows by; computes the correlation between the first two ``columns`` per group and returns a ``[by_group, Correlation]`` table.

attributes.name: add_categorization
attributes.description: If present, append a human-readable strength category for each coefficient (e.g. "Strong positive correlation", "No correlation").

attributes.name: grouped
attributes.description: Advanced: add a single correlation column computed per group between the first two ``columns``.

reset_index.description: If ``True`` (default), reset the index on the result.

numeric_only.description: If ``True`` (default), include only numeric columns in the correlation.

method.description: Correlation method passed to pandas ``corr``: ``pearson`` (default, linear), ``kendall`` (rank, tau), or ``spearman`` (rank).

by_group.description: Column to group rows by; computes the correlation between the first two ``columns`` per group and returns a ``[by_group, Correlation]`` table.

add_categorization.description: If present, append a human-readable strength category for each coefficient (e.g. "Strong positive correlation", "No correlation").

col_name.description: Name of the output correlation column.
